extracted.name: Brown Sugar Sauce
extracted.description: This sauce is a wonderful concoction that complements bread pudding, cheesecake, or pancakes on Sundays. The taste of brown sugar in a sauce form is irresistible.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a medium saucepan. Add flour and salt and stir until smooth. Stir in brown sugar and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture bubbles and is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat. Stir in boiling water.
Return to heat and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened. Stir in vanilla extract until well blended. Serve hot.
